# WalkMe
> WalkMe is a Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) that helps organizations maximize the value of their software and AI investments. It delivers real-time, in-app guidance, digital learning, automation, and insights that enable users to complete tasks efficiently and correctly across any application. By accelerating onboarding, supporting AI adoption, reducing friction, and improving user proficiency, WalkMe boosts productivity, lowers support costs, and drives measurable ROI through people-centric digital transformation at scale.
